pr_title: usb: device_next: changes around descriptor handling, preparation for the USB device class skeleton
pr_body:
Changes around descriptor handling, preparation for the USB device class skeleton

Commit 15b8df1edebf07020ee2e2b2c672267c10e7daca fixes: #58168

issue_context.title: usbd_shell: Conflict USB devices with user-defined USB device
comments: I already have a fix for that.

review_comments: Where are you using the features that dlist has that are not found in slist? The commit message mentions "next commit" but it is not in next commit and even in the last commit I didn't find (maybe I just missed) where the dlist is really needed over slist.
It is the last commit, finally, it is used to remove a list node by simply having the reference to the node.
I think the commits are overly separated. I would prefer if the helpers were added and used in the same commit.
~~They actually are, https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/58187/commits/6e1fdff22981fdcbcdec6fe91d57df7e1b14f59d.~~ Do you think I should squash it with the last commit?
I think one commit for the helpers + use helpers, keep the last commit separate.
